contract: scomp accepts a source path and optional output destination
scomp reads Sinistra source and writes verified object bytes
scomp returns zero only after successful compilation and nonzero on diagnostics
scomp emits a self-contained object without mutating the source tree
scomp reports source, lexer, parser, semantic, and output failures
sin accepts the itemstore/source-root options used by the runtime
sin loads persisted state and serves runtime/network input and output
sin returns a failure status for startup, load, or shutdown errors
sin applies its itemstore version and source-sidecar policy during startup and save
sin reports malformed state, source, runtime, and network errors
sdiss accepts an object input and disassembly/output options
sdiss reads bytecode and writes deterministic mnemonics and operands
sdiss returns nonzero for malformed input or output failure
sdiss is read-only and does not rewrite its input object
sdiss preserves verifier diagnostics and reports writer failures
sconv accepts legacy itemstore input, destination, and conversion options
sconv reads earlier itemstores and writes the latest compatible format
sconv returns nonzero when conversion or durability fails
sconv preserves atomicity and existing data when conversion fails
sconv reports bad headers, malformed records, collisions, and durability failures
